messages:
mira-sales: FinCorp asked for a compact one-page summary for their air-gapped POC covering: install packaging, upgrade cadence, rollback story, SBOM/licenses, and a cost outline. Can we bullet this quickly?
joel-eng: Short bullets from engineering: offline installer = self-contained tarball with all binaries + model weights. No outbound network calls during install. Bundles are GPG-signed and come with sha256. We produce delta bundles and full bundles.
anya-ps: For POCs we usually recommend full bundle initially, then delta for subsequent updates. Typical cadence: monthly security hotfixes + quarterly feature bundles, but we can do ad-hoc on-demand pushes.
rafa-security: Add note: customers must provide scheduled maintenance windows and snapshot backups. We'll include SPDX SBOM + license matrix (third-party libs like OpenSSL, glibc, python deps).
mira-sales: They want "one-click" rollback in the playbook. Is that realistic?
joel-eng: Provide `redwoodctl rollback --bundle <id>` that restores binaries and models. Caveat: DB migrations may be irreversible. Recommend taking DB snapshot + artifact snapshot pre-upgrade.
ops-bot: Bundle 1965432100 created and signed (GPG id: DEADBEEF). sha256: e3b0c442... :white_check_mark:
anya-ps: I'll attach a short runbook: prechecks (disk, snapshot, metrics), canary strip (1 node), smoke tests (generation + health), rollback trigger conditions.
rafa-security: For FIPS/HSM: FIPS builds are separate (add ~2 weeks). HSM/KMS key wrapping needs config & validation with customer HSM (2-3 week lead), and we need network isolation details for key exchange.
accounting: Pricing sketch: offline packaging & signing = $3,500 one-time, remote upgrade support (weekend) = $10,000 flat, onsite engineer = $5,500/day + travel. PS engagement for SLA = separate quote.
mira-sales: SLA question: can we guarantee upgrade success for the POC?
anya-ps: We can offer a validated runbook + supervised upgrade. A hard SLA for success requires a paid PS block + Dedicated environment for predictable rollback. Otherwise we state "best-effort" with documented rollback.
joel-eng: Also mention verification steps: verify GPG signature, compare sha256, run `redwoodctl health` post-install, and a short acceptance test script we can provide.
mira-sales: Great. Action list for reply: 1) attach SPDX SBOM + license table (rafa) 2) signed bundle proof + verify steps (joel) 3) upgrade playbook + rollback snippet (anya) 4) ballpark quote PDF (accounting) 5) FIPS/HSM timeline note (joel+rafa). I'll send to FinCorp and ask for preferred maintenance windows.
rafa-security: If they have specific compliance docs, have them send vendor questionnaire and we'll fill the security section.
mira-sales: Thanks team, will loop back once they confirm windows. :thumbsup:
